blind_split: Use repository fold_id exactly: fold_id=0 visible, fold_id=1 hidden. Split is not changed after inspecting outcomes.

candidate_generation.inputs: visible genotype identities and visible measured labels only
candidate_generation.method: extract exact substitutions from visible genotypes; learn single-mutation memory from all visible occurrences; learn pair residual/resonance from visible co-occurrences; enumerate or deterministic beam-compose unseen multi-mutation combinations using only substitutions observed in visible rows; freeze top candidates before hidden reveal

interpretation_rule: No success claim if generated-hidden match coverage is too sparse to evaluate. No architecture retuning after outcomes. Structural parser fixes are allowed only if they do not inspect label values.
primary_evaluation: fraction of frozen generated candidates that are independently present in hidden measured set
hidden fitness percentile of matched frozen candidates
regret versus best hidden candidate among the same generated/matchable space
